title: Softlock when interacting with the lighthouse hermit

posts.cooked:
Hey everyone, I just ran into a pretty frustrating bug while playing game-2. When I try to interact with the lighthouse hermit during the quest where he’s supposed to give you the key, the game completely softlocks. The dialogue starts playing, but after the first few lines, the voice acting cuts out and the screen just freezes. I can’t move, open menus, or do anything else, so I had to force close the game.

I double-checked the walkthrough to make sure I wasn’t missing any steps or prerequisites before talking to him, but everything seems to be in order. This happened right after completing the storm cave section, before starting the next main quest. Has anyone else encountered this? If so, did you find any way around it or a temporary fix?

Would be cool if the devs could patch this soon because it’s really blocking progress in a pretty important part of the story. For now, I guess I’ll hold off on that quest until there’s a fix or some official word. Open to hearing if anyone has ideas!

posts.cooked:
Hey, I ran into the same softlock when trying to talk to the lighthouse hermit! The cutscene triggers, but then the dialogue gets stuck on a loop, and none of the voice lines progress. I ended up having to force quit and reload an earlier save, which was a huge bummer since I was pretty far into that part.

A workaround that seems to help is making sure you’ve fully completed the previous side quest with the fishermen before initiating the conversation. I noticed that if you try talking to the hermit too early, the game gets confused and triggers the bug. Also, turning subtitles on made it easier to notice when the dialogue got stuck, so you can quit sooner if it happens.

Hopefully the devs patch this soon because the hermit’s story is one of my favorites in the game! In the meantime, I’d recommend checking the walkthrough for the exact steps to avoid missing any triggers before the interaction. Fingers crossed they fix the voice-acting lines not advancing properly — it really kills the flow.

posts.cooked:
I ran into the exact same issue when I tried to chat with the lighthouse hermit during my first playthrough. After triggering the dialogue, the game just got stuck with no way to advance or close the conversation, basically freezing the whole scene. I ended up having to reload from my last save, which was pretty frustrating since I had made good progress.

From what I’ve seen in some recent updates, it looks like this might be related to the voice-acting files not loading correctly for that specific line. If your sound settings are set to something other than default, try switching them back and see if that helps. Also, some players mentioned that following the walkthrough steps exactly—like making sure you have the lantern lit before initiating the conversation—can sometimes prevent this glitch from happening.

Hopefully the devs patch this soon because it’s a real roadblock for anyone trying to explore that part of the game. In the meantime, just be cautious when approaching the hermit and keep your saves handy!

posts.cooked:
Hey, I ran into the same issue with the lighthouse hermit interaction on my first playthrough, so I feel your frustration. From what I figured out, the softlock seems to happen specifically if you try to trigger the dialogue right after finishing the voice-acting side quest but before completing the walkthrough mission. The game kind of gets confused about which dialogue branch to load and then just freezes.

A neat workaround that worked for me was to make sure I fully completed the walkthrough mission first, then talk to the hermit. Once the walkthrough is done, the dialogue flows normally without any freezing. It’s a bit annoying since the order isn’t really explained anywhere, but at least it avoids the glitch altogether.

Hopefully, the devs patch this soon because the hermit’s voice lines add a lot to the atmosphere, and it’s such a shame to get stuck there. In the meantime, just keep an eye out to finish the related missions in the right order. If anyone else has found different workarounds or if it still happens after completing everything, please share!
